name: Biocon
about: Biocon Limited is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company, dedicated to providing innovative and affordable healthcare solutions globally. With a strong focus on treating diabetes, cancer, and autoimmune diseases, Biocon’s offerings span four key areas: generics, biosimilars, research services, and novel biologics. Supported by 13,500+ employees, Biocon leverages India’s scientific talent and cost-efficient manufacturing to deliver high-quality medicines to over 120 countries. The company’s robust pipeline and advanced therapy platforms enable it to address unmet medical needs and contribute to global health equity. Biocon is committed to enhancing access to life-saving therapies and transforming patient outcomes worldwide.
